g.text: Laplace — shared source admission, reuse and completion
9-10 Active source generation + artifact graph
provider + declared recipe + admitted resource plan
One semantic object survives physical partitioning.
Shared scheduling preserves service headroom.
No adapter-private identity or persistence loop.
11.1 Unpack into records, spans and packaging facts
Whole working set or physically partitioned stream
Single child reuses its identity.
Identity excludes tier, source, role and coordinate.
No skipping an artifact before its trunk ID exists.
11.2-11.5 Decompose exact content on client
file = [metadata, content]
source = [source record, file trunks in path order]
assign altitude and hash children bottom-up
Packing stores child identity and structure.
A realized curve resolves child coordinates.
Locality and coordinate equality are not identity.
Numerics / carrier differences require conflict review.
11.6-11.7 Compute physicalities
coordinate / Hilbert locality / typed packed path
11.8 Coalesce identical canonical rows in working set
Probe a set of IDs against canonical store / valid cache
Trunk already complete?
yes
no
Reuse its canonical subtree
retain new occurrences and distinct testimony
Retain novel rows and descend to children
yes
Unresolved trunks / lower tiers?
no
11.9-11.10 Count occurrences / containers
accumulate partition-routed streams
Ordinary content is observation, not testimony.
Structural containment / order are read from paths.
Repeated packaging is not independent witnessing.
12 Reduce by claim + witness identity
retain outcomes, games, scores, qualifiers, context
yes
Recipe declares attributable claims?
Trunk pruning depends on complete descendants.
This is the specified atomicity requirement;
reviewed implementation commit boundaries differ.
11.11 Shared writer applies new rows in bulk
leaves before parents + set merges
11.12 / 13 Fold admitted matchups in sets
exclude already-folded testimony on retry
retain FIFO where the fold is noncommutative
Record operational completion per unit / layer
11.13 Recompose from canonical paths
compare with artifact / declared loss
yes
Recipe declares reconstruction?
11.14 Independent acceptance read
entity / physicality census + fingerprints
work receipt + resumable journal
Specified source lifecycle, not proof that a command implements it.
Completion state and a receipt are not independent acceptance evidence.
Source: Sequence/Content.md and Laplace/AGENTS.md.
